transcript.content: Due to a recent decline in business sales, I have significant anxiety and stress; I tend to catastrophize the problem, believing the decline will continue throughout the year, and it has caused sleep disturbance and decreased appetite. I feel extremely hopeless, and have even thought about ending my life and leaving this world.

[System B PsychAgent] Thank you for sharing your current situation (Significant Anxiety and pressure from recent declining business sales, tending to catastrophize the problem and believing the decline will last all year). In BT counseling, we will use cognitive and behavioral frameworks to explore the core distress.
